category_title: Students who prioritize narrative storytelling over evidence-based scientific explanation
scenario_title: Clarifying complex classroom instructions for ELL students
minimal_context: The student is participating in a group work activity during a Fossil Finders science and math lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please review the Fossil Finders data and discuss the science and math evidence in your groups in English.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns to group) ¿Entienden las instrucciones? I think we should just say the T. rex escaped.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What does the data tell you?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It's a story about dinosaur eggs. (To group) Es más fácil explicarlo en español. Había un huevo aquí...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please focus on the formal instructions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues speaking informally in Spanish to the group) Sí, el T. rex se escapó. No necesitamos usar la evidencia de matemáticas, solo escribamos la historia en español.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please review the Fossil Finders data and discuss the science and math evidence in your groups in English.

STUDENT: (Turns to group) ¿Entienden las instrucciones? I think we should just say the T. rex escaped.

TUTOR: What does the data tell you?

STUDENT: It's a story about dinosaur eggs. (To group) Es más fácil explicarlo en español. Había un huevo aquí...

TUTOR: Please focus on the formal instructions.

STUDENT: (Continues speaking informally in Spanish to the group) Sí, el T. rex se escapó. No necesitamos usar la evidencia de matemáticas, solo escribamos la historia en español.

task.content: General classroom communication during the Fossil Finders unit.

context.environment: General classroom interaction and group work during science and math instruction in a dual-language middle school setting.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When ELL students need clarification on complex classroom instructions or scientific tasks.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: informally used Spanish in their groups on a regular basis

behavior_patterns.condition: General classroom communication during the Fossil Finders unit.
